Name: Archipelago Multiworld
Description:
Connects Timberborn 1.1 to the Archipelago Multiworld Randomizer. Building blueprints normally unlocked through Science are shuffled across a multiworld, so you survive on whatever tech arrives while sending checks that unlock buildings for other players. By default you start with the Forester, Stairs and Platform blueprints.

Supports both Folktails and Iron Teeth factions. Requires Timberborn 1.1 and an Archipelago server running the Timberborn APWorld.
